text:
jamie: heads-up — deploybot reported model-serving latency drift on engine-prod us-west-2 around 19:02 :eyes:
deploybot: [automated] ALERT: latency_p95 increased 2.3x vs baseline for engine:v3.1-quant on pool gpu-a (samples: 120) — looking for cloudy spikes. Link: https://telemetry.internal/alert/3512346789
marina: seeing the alert, checking canary traces now. can anyone confirm if this aligns with the kernel-abi swap from last night?
kai: yes we swapped kernel-abi v2.12 -> v2.13 at 02:30. canary looked fine overnight but regional traffic bumped at 18:50.
devon: quick repro on staging: reproduced 15% request latency tail when sequence >1024 with quant build v3.1. suspect matmul path fallback.
jamie: ok let's not panic. plan suggestion: pin traffic for affected pool to engine:v3.0-quant (previous bundle) for us-west-2, set a temporary pin TTL 2h, and run extended smoke. /deploy pin --scope=pool:gpu-a --target=engine:v3.0-quant --ttl=2h
kai: +1 to pin. can we gate that with a preflight check so we don't cause further flapping?
marina: add preflight: run 1000 short tokens and 200 long tokens seq>1024, check p95 and mismatched outputs (sanity compare). I can run that once pinned.
deploybot: /pin accepted — applying pin to pool:gpu-a -> engine:v3.0-quant. Action ID: PB-3512346789-1. Rolling pin across nodes now. ETA ~2m.
ops-bot: NOTE: Pin applied by deploybot. Don’t forget to update release notes and open a follow-up rollback-playbook ticket.
devon: sending quick telemetry dump: `curl telemetry.internal/metrics?alert=3512346789` shows KV-cache miss spike correlated with evict_count + cpu steal on host-7. Might be runtime kernel scheduling difference.
kai: good catch. if kernel scheduling is the culprit we should engage eng-infra and kernel owners. tagging @kernel-team FYI.
jamie: marina, after pin completes can you run the extended smoke and paste results here? aim for p95 <= baseline*1.2 and zero output-variance for short tokens.
marina: pin done, running smoke now. short tokens pass. long tokens in progress — currently p95 at 1.1x baseline, no functional diffs so far. attaching minimal logs: ```SMOKE_RESULT: long_seq_p95=1.08; diffs=0/200; error_rate=0.0```
devon: nice. can we hold pin for 2h then promote a staged rollback plan to re-deploy kernel-abi with a micropatch that reverts scheduling tweak? need perf bench first.
kai: I'll queue a microbench job on canary pool and ask infra to check host pressure. if kernel patch required we'll need a coord window.
jamie: decision: keep pin for 2h, open follow-up ticket RFC-3512346789 describing drift, attach smoke logs, assign to @kai and @devon, and draft release-note blurb explaining temporary pin and investigation. I'll also notify on-call infra. :thumbsup:
marina: created ticket https://tickets.internal/RFC-3512346789 with logs and smoke artifacts. added label incident:drift and priority:high.
deploybot: PB-3512346789-1 will auto-expire at +2h if not extended. Use `/deploy extend PB-3512346789-1 --hours=1` to extend.
jamie: thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes draft and post an ops summary in #incidents if we escalate. For now we track telemetry; ping here with any regressions.
kai: pinging infra on-call.
marina: will keep live tail on until pin expires. :coffee:
deploybot: [automated] NOTE: telemetry baseline resumed for pinned pool. p95 delta now 1.02x.
jamie: closing loop for now — decision backed: pin rescue applied, smoke green, follow-ups created. we will reconvene if telemetry crosses 1.3x again.
marina: ack
devon: ack
